fnol_text: My name is Owen Whitfield and I live at 414 Larkspur Avenue, Madison, WI 53739. You can reach me on (555) 603-2381 or owen.whitfield@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 29 October 2026. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2025-00091. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Can you confirm I'm covered for this?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Whitfield on (555) 603-2381 to acknowledge the claim. Owen confirmed the loss date as 29 October 2026.
Site visit to 414 Larkspur Avenue. Neighbour Fatima Takahashi was present and confirmed the timeline.
Owen sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
